fieldValues.title: Groups sit beside each other, not nested
fieldValues.decision_question: Are working groups nested or side by side?
fieldValues.context: D10 of clerk#57 (plans/wg-srs-operations.md, section 8), asked of the owner since 2026-10-12. Recorded as a proposed decision on 2026-10-16 so a session can take it: until now it existed only as PR text, which no session agenda reads.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Groups sit beside each other rather than nested, unless an observed overlap is recorded in a decision that nests them.
fieldValues.rationale: Nesting adds structure before any overlap has been observed (proposal sections 4 to 6).
fieldValues.revisit_when: Two cycles after a second group shares repos with another.
